name: Kariya Maki
source:
A very mature and pragmatic women who acts as a parental figure for the group. She also has a past of her own that she will not reveal without some effort. She seeks to understand the mysteries of the Forest so that everyone can escape from this strange land alive and continue with their lives.

[Edited from [url=http://theothersideofanime.blogspot.com/2014/03/forest-review-no-spoilers-here_24.html]The Other Side of Anime[/url]]
